topic: What trade-offs exist between array size and radiation efficiency for SIW arrays in high-gain inter-satellite antennas?
consensus_response: Increasing array size enhances gain but introduces higher insertion losses, reducing radiation efficiency. Material selection, thermal management, and adaptive beamforming mitigate these effects, balancing performance and resource allocation.
reference_context: SIW arrays face trade-offs between gain and efficiency due to insertion losses, with material properties and thermal stability impacting performance.
